SELECT trend.stat_date, trend.total_send_count, trend.total_success_count, trend.billing_cost, trend.max_cost FROM ( SELECT ms.stat_date, ms.total_send_count, ms.total_success_count, ms.billing_cost, ms.max_cost FROM message_stat ms WHERE ORDER BY ms.stat_date DESC FETCH FIRST 7 ROWS ONLY ) trend ORDER BY trend.stat_date
